basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Seattle, Washington, with a passion for robotics and gaming. My interest in technology started when I was a kid, tinkering with old computers and building simple bots. I enjoy spending my free time creating intricate machines in games like Scrap Mechanic and exploring narrative-driven games by Bioware. When I'm not online, I love attending live music events and discovering new artists. My online hours are typically in the evening after work, and I often stay up late on weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoy the flexibility of focusing on my hobbies and career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 6 years. My expertise lies in software development and robotics, which I've honed through both formal education and self-teaching. I frequently engage in online communities to share insights and learn new techniques, especially in robotics and game mechanics.
